description.title: A private experience with service from pickup
description.paragraph: FPM Private Charter includes a private flight, premium private round-trip transport, a bilingual guide from pickup and archaeological site admission. Enjoy a light buffet breakfast before take-off, a champagne toast, photos and video, waiter service, canapés and snacks, and brunch at Club Campestre. Confirm the guests covered and booking minimum.
